title: Spare Key — Chapter 4
narration: We found Sophie beside Adam's open grave, holding his key. The coffin was empty. Inside lay a burner phone playing a video recorded before the crash. Adam was kissing me, but I had a different face. We'll make it look accidental, he said. Once Claire is gone, Sophie will accept you as her mother. My knees weakened. I had known Adam. I had helped plan Claire's murder. Mara removed her hood. My real name is Claire, she said. You stole my husband, then the surgeons gave you my face. She had survived the fire. Adam hadn't. At least, that was what she wanted me to believe. Sophie climbed into the grave and removed a metal box beneath the coffin. Inside was a recent photograph of Adam holding today's newspaper. Across it: Neither woman remembers the truth. Sophie looked at us and smiled. Daddy says only one of you can come home.
